findings.message: 'resource' is a soft reserved keyword as of PHP version 7.0 and should not be used to name a class, interface, trait or enum or as part of a namespace (class declaration) (resource has been a soft reserved name since PHP 7.0 and naming a class Resource never raises an error, so nothing changes on newer PHP)
